subject: general
question: 5 girls A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only E is to the left of D. Only C is to the right of A. Who is in the middle of the row?
solution:
Given: Five girls A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north.

Only E is to the left of D.

Only C is to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c252e2bfbc5a41db971d6c285725ba2282177e6fd28978ad354599ea07c2e700.png] 

Middle position (3rd seat) = B

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
